## One statement that needs correcting to him

**"Airtable receives the test result and deflection data"** for Static Load. **LabOS does not send deflection
data and cannot yet** — `Deflection Value` and `Deflection Unit` are `UNMET-UNCALIBRATED`: the rigs return
raw gauge counts never calibrated to a physical unit, and the envelope refuses them in both the columns and
the JSON.

This matters more than a wording slip, because the **Airtable team is being told the opposite** in
`../testing-base-change-document-2026-09-08.md` §4 — *"we would rather send nothing than send a number we
cannot stand behind"*. Two outgoing statements that contradict each other, to two parties who talk to each
other.

Correct it in a follow-up rather than by editing anything: *deflections are recorded locally and withheld
from Airtable until the gauges are calibrated to a real unit; the same is true of `Max Pressure Achieved`,
for a different reason — no source persists it yet.* The approval document he has says this on the Static
Load page; the summary in this message did not carry it.

Also worth a light touch in the same reply: **"we've now implemented … Impact"** is ahead of the build. The
per-impact shape he specified on 2026-09-08 is designed and decided (§4.5a) and not yet implemented — TC1h.
He will read "implemented" as done, and the honest version costs one clause.
